decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch that closely extends the firm's automation portfolio, it still has option value under high early uncertainty and fits the firm's strategic push toward smarter automation, so withdrawal within a year is unlikely.

This is an incremental product close to the established offer, so the cost of keeping it on the market is likely modest while additional market learning can still be gained, making continuation the likely choice.

Although more distant from the core offer and therefore more uncertain and resource-demanding, the standalone presentation and 2024 design award provide enough positive signal for management to keep the option open rather than abandon it immediately.
